answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 165114 Country: India Title: May I buy bike from auction sale? It's permissible or not? Question: May I buy bike from auction sale? It's permissible or not? Answer ID: 165114 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 102/92/H=03/1440) As many things are sold and purchased on auction day and night, in the same way it is lawful to buy or sell bike on auction as well. If you have any doubt or objection then write it clearly and submit your question again. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
